note: Set A's first claim correctly captures the ~100 issues and concerns from initial LCIT reviews across four mission concepts, but its other two claims restate the same number misbound: one attributes 100 findings to the Draft Final Reports themselves, and one claims the mission concepts have a quantity of 100 (there are four concepts; 100 is the issue count). Set B's single claim is accurate, well-bound and fully supported by its quote. Since unshown claims are identical in both sets, Set A's two extra claims are pure errors and duplicates.
remarks: Set A appears to have generated derivative claims by re-parsing the same sentence fragment ('Draft Final Reports resulted in approximately 100'), producing duplicate and misbound restatements of one fact. The page also states the final set of remaining issues was significantly reduced after LCIT re-review, but neither set quantifies it (no number is given on the page, so nothing is missing numerically).
